modules.name: tb_voice_operators
modules.description: 四个独立算子的并发参考向量、连续吞吐、反压和复位取消验证。

ports.name: o_done
ports.description: 最终轮所有算子事务完成；供外层仿真夹具观察

behavior: Four independent input streams use Python reference vectors.
Reset at cycle 70 cancels 15 pipeline transactions; restart tags use another epoch.
No-stall latency is 3/4/4/4; each operator accepts every cycle.
No source or destination payload may change while that transfer is stalled.
constraints: Testbench only; not synthesizable and not included in board source lists.
Run from voice-engine directory so vectors paths resolve.
verification_cases: output tags and results remain stable on stalls

timing_diagrams.title: 阻塞期间复位撤销任务
timing_diagrams.description: 在输出被反压时断言复位，清除有效位；释放后使用新 epoch。
